Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: John's HVAC Solutions specializes in providing air conditioning and heating sales and service for residential and light commercial properties. Our operations include routine maintenance, repairs, and installations of various HVAC systems with a focus on energy efficiency and customer satisfaction. We prioritize ongoing technician training and hold certifications such as EPA Section 608 for refrigerant handling to ensure compliance with industry standards. Our digital operations are secured with robust cybersecurity measures to protect client data and mitigate risks associated with data breaches and ransomware attacks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2021, a service technician accidentally damaged a residential air conditioning unit during routine maintenance, resulting in a loss of $5,000. The claim was settled, and the status is closed. On 10/10/2022, the business faced a data breach due to a cyber-attack, leading to expenses amounting to $10,000 for cybersecurity audits and client notifications. This claim is currently in process, with resolution expected by the end of 2023.
